# ffxf_database_public_access (Resource)

Manages the public_access feature of an FFXF Cloud database. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_database_public_access" "example" {
  database_id = 42
  enabled     = true
  sources     = ["203.0.113.10/32"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) Parent database ID.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the database accepts public connections.

### Optional

- `sources` (List of String) Allowed IPv4 or IPv6 addresses/CIDRs. An empty list allows all sources.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this managed database object.
